completed_features.title: Project Foundation & Practitioner Navigation Shell
completed_features.scope: Initialized Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Supabase SSR setup. Created domain types, database migration SQL with RLS policies, patient and dashboard services, layout components (Sidebar, Header), practitioner dashboard page, and patient roster page with search and status filtering.
completed_features.layman_summary: We set up the core building blocks of Lumina Health! You can now launch the app, see a clean side navigation menu and top header, view a main Practitioner Dashboard displaying your daily statistics and scheduled appointments, and navigate to an active Patient Roster page with search and status filtering.

completed_features.title: Interactive Session Scheduler & Calendar View
completed_features.scope: Created /calendar page route, CalendarView component, NewAppointmentModal booking form, and appointmentService.ts backend module with getAppointments(), createAppointment(), and updateAppointmentStatus() handlers.
completed_features.layman_summary: You now have a dedicated Calendar page! You can visually view your upcoming therapy appointments, filter sessions by status (Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled), book new client sessions using a pop-up scheduling window, and mark completed sessions with a single click.

completed_features.title: Comprehensive Patient Detail Profile & Clinical History View
completed_features.scope: Created dynamic /patients/[id] route, PatientProfileHeader, PatientAppointmentHistory, PatientNotesHistory, PatientDetailTabs components, noteService.ts, and integrated getPatientById(), getAppointmentsByPatientId(), and getNotesByPatientId() service handlers.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now click on any patient from the Patient Roster to open their dedicated Clinical Profile page! You will see their full demographic details, primary ailment focus, contact information, a complete timeline of structured past session notes (with clinical discoveries and assigned daily actions), and their full appointment history.

completed_features.title: Add New Patient Registration & Patient Roster Management
completed_features.scope: Created AddPatientModal.tsx, PatientRosterView.tsx, CreatePatientInput interface in lib/types/index.ts, and implemented createPatient() and updatePatient() handlers in patientService.ts. Enforced mandatory validations, DSM-5 primary focus dropdown, @-mention secondary tag system, click-outside modal dismissal, and React Portal rendering.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now register new patients with mandatory DSM-5 primary diagnosis dropdowns, @-mention secondary comorbidity tags, and a responsive intake window with click-outside closure.

completed_features.title: Structured Clinical Note Creation Modal & Quick Entry Tool
completed_features.scope: Created components/notes/NewClinicalNoteModal.tsx, updated Header.tsx and PatientNotesHistory.tsx, and integrated createNote() and getAllNotes() in lib/services/noteService.ts. Enables structured clinical note logging with patient selection, session date picker, discoveries tag pills (@CBT-Insight), assigned client homework items list adder, and raw session summary notes.
completed_features.layman_summary: You can now add structured session notes from anywhere in the app! Clicking '+ Note' in the top header or '+ Add Note' in a patient's chart opens a quick pop-up window where you can select a patient, tag key clinical findings (like CBT insights or anxiety triggers), assign client homework/daily action tasks, and save session summaries directly to their clinical record.

completed_features.title: Global Header Real-Time Search & Quick Actions Hub
completed_features.scope: Created components/layout/GlobalSearchBar.tsx, updated Header.tsx, created lib/services/searchService.ts, and added SearchResultItem DTO in lib/types/index.ts. Enables live real-time multi-resource practice search across Patients, Clinical Notes, and Appointments with debounced queries, categorized icons/badges, click-outside dismissal, Esc shortcut, and instant navigation.
completed_features.layman_summary: You now have a powerful live search bar right in the top navigation header! As you type a patient name, clinical tag (like @CBT-Insight), or session date, a floating menu instantly displays categorized search results across your patients, session notes, and calendar appointments, letting you jump directly to any record with one click.

proposed_features.title: Clinical Note Editing & Management Module
proposed_features.scope: Extends the clinical notes system to allow practitioners to edit, amend, and delete existing session notes, ensuring clinical records can be corrected and updated.

proposed_features.title: Patient Record Archive & Status Lifecycle Management
proposed_features.scope: Adds controls to change patient statuses (Active, Inactive, Completed Therapy, Archived) with filtered roster views.

pending_options.title: AI-Assisted Clinical Pattern Recognition
pending_options.scope: Background analytical engine examining structured discoveries and daily actions to highlight correlations for practitioners.
